notes:
Summary: Mid-market SaaS (product + customer-success stack) evaluating Hosted API first; completed 3-week POC on hosted to validate latency and quality, now negotiating Dedicated reserved capacity and pricing. Team: Head of Product (Ethan Li), CTO (Priya Anand), Infra Lead (Samir Rao). AE Jordan; SE Maya; CSM Ana involved for ramp planning.

POC highlights (hosted API):
- 3-week PoC (10k sessions, 1.2M tokens). Observed avg chat latency: 65-120ms per token on hosted for standard prompts; 99p tail ~240ms during synthetic load.
- Embeddings used for document ranking (2M docs index), recall improved vs current vector store pipeline.
- Cost: POC spend $12.4k; CFO flagged unit cost as primary concern.

Business drivers / requirements:
- Primary workload: support-agent + semantic search for product docs and KB; occasional code-assist helper for internal ops.
- Latency SLO: 95p < 250ms for chat flows; p50 target ~80-100ms.
- Throughput: steady 350 concurrent user sessions, spiky peaks up to ~1,200 concurrent sessions during releases. Need burst handling.
- Cost sensitivity: target unit economics ~ $0.002/token or lower for steady traffic; willing to commit for discounts if predictable.
- Model preferences: open models preferred; evaluate Redwood-verified GLM variants and 8-bit quantized options. Need fallback to hosted variants if Dedicated lacks capacity.

Dedicated negotiation specifics discussed:
- Proposed commit: 12-month term, committed baseline capacity equivalent to ~2x A100 40GB sustained (internal estimate) with guaranteed throughput for 24/7 workloads.
- Ramp schedule request from Reefward: Q1 30% of commit, Q2 60%, Q3 100% (allows gradual onboarding of agents).
- Burst policy: allow bursts to 3x baseline for up to 6 hours/day during product releases; overage during bursts charged at 1.4x committed unit price. Reefward asked for 2x burst for free first 30 days.
- Overage model: per-token overage billing with soft cap alerts; SE proposed tiered overage: 1-20% over commit = 1.25x, 20-50% = 1.5x, >50% = 2x. Reefward pushing for single flat 1.5x.
- Price protection: Reefward requests fixed per-token price for first 12 months and notification window for model/price changes.
- Reserved pricing: Redwood offered progressive discounts by commit band (5% @ baseline, 12% @ mid, 20% @ enterprise). Reefward targeting mid band.

Security & deployment asks:
- VPC peering + private control plane preferred.
- KMS integration for CMK and audit logs exported to their Splunk; retention 365d minimum.
- SOC2 Type II evidence required; iso27001 not mandatory but helpful.
- Data residency: US-only for customer data.

POC -> Dedicated technical validation:
- SE ran stress test on dedicated-like instance (synthetic) to project throughput; passed concurrency targets with KV cache enabled.
- Request for an on-site (or video) runbook walkthrough with ops team before sign. Scheduled deep-dive 2024-12-20 (Fireflies: ff_20241220_runbook).

Commercial outstanding items:
- Final commit TL;DR: Reefward wants 12-month commitment with a 6-month opt-out after a ramp milestone (negotiable).
- Billing cadence: monthly invoicing preferred; finance requests clear monthly usage reports + token-level breakdown.
- SLA credits: Reefward to include 99.9% uptime for inference; penalty schedule still under discussion.
